description: Fetch recent Sealgate agent sessions and audit events so you can see what agents did, which data flowed, and any blocked actions. Returns a paginated page of sessions (agent_name, user_email, created_at, status, tool_call_count, trifecta_flags, block_severity, acl_level).

perPage.description: Maximum sessions to return per page (default 50)

status.description: Filter by session status (e.g. active, completed)

name: get_session_status
title: Get recent session and audit status
